data.title: The Hradiská association and its work in 2013
data.excerpt: The HISTORYWEB portal has published an article briefly summarising the work of the Hradiská civic association in 2013. Its own articles and photo reports on the information panels created that year can be read by following the links below the pictures of the panels.
data.metaTitle: The Hradiská association and its work in 2013
data.metaDescription: A summary of the work of the Hradiská civic association in 2013 – information panels, photo reports and public outreach about Slovakia's hillforts.

children.text: On the excellent web portal HISTORYWEB you have the chance to read an article which briefly summarises the work of our civic association Hradiská in 2013.
You will find the article at this address:

You can read the individual articles and photo reports about our panels created in 2013 in more detail by clicking on the text below the pictures of the panels shown here:
 
 It should be added that this year our civic association Hradiská is applying for 2 % of your income tax. The money will be used partly for further information panels, but also to pay for good-quality texts by specialists – archaeologists and historians – and for good-quality drawings; and if we manage to raise a larger sum, we can also consider more significant and more demanding projects. Our 2 % donation form will be available for download in the near future.
